title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.1.6.322
body_markdown:
### Added

* New tool window "GitHub Copilot" to replace the split editor of the "Open Copilot" feature.

### Changed

* Completions should be successfully displayed for more files now.

### Fixed

* Several causes of exceptions in the editor and the new tool window.
* Dispose Copilot inlays after "Cut Line" action.
